issues.description: Field visibility mismatch for Lecture attributes: the template declares two public fields (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents) while the exercise UML and the provided solution declare all five attributes as private. Specifically, template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declares: public String lectureName; and public int numberOfInscribedStudents; (lines 4-5). The problem statement UML shows the attributes as private (Lecture attributes at problem_statement.md lines 63-69 with '-' visibility). The solution implementation defines the full set of private attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java (lines 6-10). This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended visibility, and will lead to compile errors or duplicate-field declarations if students follow the UML/solution and add private fields with the same names.
